name: side-float-page-complete-roundtrip
rows: The controlled observations in the final measured region show
a stable relation across independent trials and preserve the
ordinary paragraph boundaries. All further estimates
of the measured outcomes in the final controlled sample are
linear measurements. The detailed evidence remains consistent
with the controlled trial and its complete native ownership.
Every independent boundary and the conclusion are confirmed.
translation: 最终测量区域的受控观测显示，各次独立试验具有稳定关系，并保留普通段落边界。对这些值的进一步估计是线性测量。详细证据与受控试验及其完整的原生对象归属保持一致。每个独立边界和结论都得到确认。
